payload.rationale: The packet provides partial support but does not establish the full event-triggered special-monitoring characterization to the burden required for ACCEPT, and nothing establishes that the characterization is false for REJECT. Excerpt gcc/final_permit.pdf page 4 section part_i — "(2) Perform WET testing at first discharge." — grounds an event trigger for WET at first discharge, but the obligation also frames Once/5 years as part of the alternative characterization; the separate "Ceriodaphnia dubia Report Once/5 years" line at the same location does not explicitly name WET, so the frequency limb is not grounded to parameter WET. No excerpt binds source gcc/final_permit.pdf to permit referent NM0000116. The packet also does not establish whether WET is instead a monthly DMR numeric limit; absence of a monthly DMR row is not closed-world evidence of distinct monitoring class. Cover-page dates and the FY2025 window excerpt scope timing but do not resolve the monitoring-type question. Preferring unsupported uncertainty to unsupported semantic closure.
